title: Reconcile entities without implementation-deck references
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can identify Systems and Components without implementation-deck references and decide how to reconcile them so the inventory remains connected to the application's feature implementations.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An entity with no implementation-deck reference is accounted for only when explicitly designated new or proposed; otherwise the report identifies that entity as requiring a user decision.
For an unreferenced entity not designated new/proposed, the workflow asks the user what to do rather than silently reclassify, delete, or attach it to an arbitrary feature.
The gap exposes the entity's identity, explanation, evidence state, and absence of implementation-deck usages so the user can determine where it belongs.
